svg.title: Sri Yantra: 43 chambers recovered from geometry
svg.desc: Computed Huet reference geometry. Five colors identify circuits of 14, 10, 10, 8 and 1 triangular chambers. Dark gaps remain unselected.

g.text: Sri Yantra: chambers derived from geometry
Huet reference parameters • finite edges • numerical incidence
They do not tile the whole figure.
Selection: odd generator coverage. Ring depth: minimum edge crossings from the exterior.
Numerically verified for this planar reference. Historical spherical and Meru incidence maps remain open.
